verdict.rationale: Munito AI's own docs describe an API reference with request schemas, code examples and an API playground, which covers both the interactive reference and the runnable examples. A probe confirms a live OpenAPI contract, and quickstarts provide cURL, Python and TypeScript examples. The playground itself appears only as a single brief claim. Missing for 10: detail on how the playground works (in-browser execution, authentication, which endpoints it covers), plus independent or hands-on confirmation that the playground runs requests.
